title: Simulator usage
text: Parameter specifications can constants, vectors indexed time, matrices indexed subject time, functions generated long-format design. Vectors marginal parameters one value per time point. Vectors copula parameters one value per adjacent time edge. copula parameter can supplied theta/par, Kendall’s tau. Using tau often easier goal describe dependence strength common scale across copula families.

title: Simulator usage
text: Use simulate_longitudinal_covariates() inside covariates callback want clear split subject-level variables observation-level variables. Subject-level variables generated per subject repeated across time. Observation-level variables generated per row. Inside marginal parameter functions, d long-format subject-time data. Inside copula parameter functions, e adjacent-pair edge data. Edge data contains covariates left right rows needed, including time variables time_left time_right. helper functions sim_rescale01(), sim_factor_effect(), sim_smooth_*() shapes small building blocks readable truth specifications. optional; ordinary R code works well.
code: treatment_effect <- c(control = 0, active = 0.4)  dat <- simulate_longitudinal_dataset(   n = 120,   times = seq(0, 1, length.out = 5),   margin_dist = GA(mu.link = "log", sigma.link = "log"),   covariates = function(base) {     simulate_longitudinal_covariates(       base,       subject = list(         treatment = function(s) {           factor(             sample(c("control", "active"), nrow(s), replace = TRUE),             levels = c("control", "active")           )         },         age = function(s) rnorm(nrow(s), mean = 55, sd = 10)       ),       observation = list(         time_scaled = function(d) sim_rescale01(d$time)       )     )   },   margin_params = list(     mu = function(d) {       age_scaled <- sim_rescale01(d$age)       eta <- 1.2 +         sim_factor_effect(d$treatment, treatment_effect) +         0.35 * d$time_scaled +         sim_smooth_bump(age_scaled, amplitude = 0.25)       exp(eta)     },     sigma = function(d) {       exp(-0.8 + 0.25 * d$time_scaled)     }   ),   copula_dist = "N",   copula_params = list(     theta = function(e) {       0.2 + 0.25 * sim_rescale01(e$time_left)     }   ),   seed = 3 )  head(dat)
